title: O17 — Constructing irreducible polynomials over finite fields
exact_target: Can an irreducible polynomial of any prescribed degree over any prime field be constructed deterministically in time polynomial in the degree and logarithm of the prime?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, supplied problems.json, record 8400019 (AMR-083-0019), AMR Open Problem Lists. Catalogue identity and source transcription; CC BY 4.0.
Adleman \& McCurley - Open Problems in Number Theory Complexity II (1994), O17, p14 / LNCS p304. Original source indexed by AMR-083-0019.
S. S. Rai, Pseudo-Deterministic Construction of Irreducible Polynomials over Finite Fields (2024). A randomized notion distinct from deterministic construction.

status_qualification: Polynomial time is polynomial in d and log p, consistent with dense polynomial output; d is an output-size parameter.
